answer.text:
Microsoft’s gross margin percentage for the three months ended December 31, 2024 was **68.7%**.

Calculation: **Gross margin ÷ Revenue × 100** = **$47,833 million ÷ $69,632 million × 100 = 68.7%** (rounded to one decimal place).

Source: Microsoft 10-Q, accession **0000950170-25-010491**, “Summary Results of Operations,” Item 2, chunk **c0afa9dd-a3a0-52f0-907e-3491234bc030**.
